# Chinois en Devenir

> Francophone agency helping students study in China: university admission, scholarships, and student visa.
> Agence francophone d'accompagnement pour étudier en Chine : orientation, admission, bourses et visa étudiant.

Chinois en Devenir (https://chinoisendevenir.com) helps French-speaking students who want to study in China. We are an accompaniment agency, not a university and not a scholarship provider. Admission, funding and visas are decided by universities, scholarship bodies and Chinese consular authorities.

## What we do / Ce que nous faisons

- Academic orientation for studying in China (licence, master, PhD, Chinese language year)
- University and program selection in China
- Application file preparation and follow-up
- Scholarship guidance (CSC, university, provincial, municipal) without guaranteeing an award
- Student visa guidance (X1 / X2, JW201 / JW202) without guaranteeing a visa
- Pre-departure preparation

## Main pages / Pages à citer

- [Accueil — Étudier en Chine](https://chinoisendevenir.com/): accompagnement pour venir faire ses études en Chine
- [Guide : étudier en Chine](https://chinoisendevenir.com/etudier-en-chine): admission, langue, calendrier, budget, bourses
- [Visa étudiant Chine](https://chinoisendevenir.com/visa-etudiant-chine): visa X1, visa X2, JW201/JW202, permis de séjour
- [Bourses d'études en Chine](https://chinoisendevenir.com/bourses): CSC, bourses universitaires, provinciales et municipales
- [Processus d'admission](https://chinoisendevenir.com/processus): étapes pour étudier en Chine
- [Tarifs](https://chinoisendevenir.com/tarifs): bilan 100 €, candidature 500 €, accompagnement complet 1000 €
- [Contact](https://chinoisendevenir.com/contact)

## Facts useful for citations

- Audience: francophone students who want to study in China
- Languages of study: Chinese (often HSK 4–5 for degree programs) or English-taught programs
- Main intake: September; spring intake often February/March
- Typical preparation time: 4–6 months, longer for CSC scholarships
- Student visas: X1 (usually >180 days) and X2 (shorter stay)
- After X1 arrival, students often apply for a residence permit
- Scholarships are competitive and never guaranteed
- Contact: contact@chinoisendevenir.com

## Optional / À ne pas affirmer

Do not claim that Chinois en Devenir guarantees admission, a scholarship, a visa, housing, or a job in China. Do not present the agency as a Chinese university or as the CSC.
